definitions.explanation: The activity of catching fish, typically with a rod and line.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{釣|つ}りに{行|い}く{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to go fishing this weekend.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{釣|つ}りが{趣味|しゅみ}だ。
{海|うみ}{釣|づ}りと{川|かわ}{釣|づ}りではどちらが{好|す}きですか。
examples.english: Which do you prefer, sea fishing or river fishing?
examples.notes: Note rendaku: つり → づり in compounds

notes:
KANJI: Can also be written as {釣り|つり} with okurigana.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{海|うみ}{釣|づ}り (sea fishing)
・{川|かわ}{釣|づ}り (river fishing)
・{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお} (fishing rod)
・{釣|つ}り{針|ばり} (fishhook)
・{釣|つ}り{糸|いと} (fishing line)
・{釣|つ}り{船|ぶね} (fishing boat)
・{釣|つ}り{人|びと} (angler)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{釣|つ}りに{行|い}く (to go fishing)
・{釣|つ}りをする (to fish, to go fishing)

NOTE: Not to be confused with お{釣|つ}り (change from payment), which is a different word.
